Keyboard shortcuts
j / k
move down / up a row
h / l
collapse subtree / expand or descend
Enter
open the span detail panel
/
focus the search box
z
zoom the time axis to the selected span
+ / − / 0
zoom in / out / fit
e / c
errors only / critical path highlight
Esc
close popover, clear search

On the time axis: drag to pan, Shift+wheel to pan, Ctrl+wheel or a horizontal wheel to zoom, double-click a row to zoom to that span. Drag inside the minimap to pan, drag outside the window to select a range.
